mind2web.additional_instruction: Do not redistribute unzipped test files online; do not place benchmark data in training corpora.

public_candidate: author-created source code after a root code license is selected
documentation without source screenshots or substantial source text
supervisor_only: exact Mind2Web test identifiers and benchmark hashes
Mind2Web-derived per-item requirements and verification annotations
PURE-derived per-item annotations containing full requirement text
per-item predictions and raw model responses
sanitized launch manifests containing test identifiers
excluded_from_public_release: Mind2Web test archives and unzipped records
Mind2Web screenshots, HTML, MHTML, HAR, traces, videos, and session data
PURE PDFs, XML files, extracted figures, and embedded images
API keys, secrets, account data, and billing identifiers
required_before_public_release: path, secret, personal-data, and source-content audit
written permission for any broader per-item release
